say:0:1110101001:0.text: Wow! So much sand! Chippy has never seen so much sand!
say:0:1110101001:0.source_cn: 呜哇！好多沙子！第一次见到这么多沙子！

say:1:1110101002:0.text: I've only ever read about places like this in storybooks... It reminds me of a giant ocean of sand!
say:1:1110101002:0.source_cn: 之前只在书里看到过，现在亲眼见到，简直就像超级大的浴场...

say:2:1110101003:0.text: Chippy wants to take off his armor and dive in!
say:2:1110101003:0.source_cn: 我都想脱下盔甲，钻进沙子好好打几个滚了！

say:0:1110102001:0.text: But our main mission is to find this fake Merlin as soon as possible!
say:0:1110102001:0.source_cn: 不过，现在的当务之急是尽快找到那个假梅林！
say:0:1110102001:0.male: But our main mission is to find this fake Merlin as soon as possible!
say:0:1110102001:0.female: But our main mission is to find this fake Merlin as soon as possible!

say:1:1110102002:0.text: Sir Chippy must defend Magister Merlin's good name!
say:1:1110102002:0.source_cn: 骑士满满要捍卫梅林大人的名誉！
say:1:1110102002:0.male: Sir Chippy must defend Magister Merlin's good name!
say:1:1110102002:0.female: Sir Chippy must defend Magister Merlin's good name!

say:1:1110103001:1.text: The reputation of our magister is sacred! Sir Chippy, a knight of the realm, swears to restore his name!
say:1:1110103001:1.source_cn: 主人的名誉，不可侵犯！贴身护卫的骑士满满——
say:1:1110103001:1.male: The reputation of our magister is sacred! Sir Chippy, a knight of the realm, swears to restore his name!
say:1:1110103001:1.female: The reputation of our magister is sacred! Sir Chippy, a knight of the realm, swears to restore her name!

say:4:1110103003:0.text: Of course, Chippy is! Wait a minute... You just popped up out of nowhere! Who are you?!
say:4:1110103003:0.source_cn: 哼哼，当然！等等！突然冒出来搭话……你是什么东西？

say:5:1110103004:0.text: Isn't it obvious? I'm Trezzy, a treasure-hunting hamster familiar!
say:5:1110103004:0.source_cn: 不明显吗？我当然是仓鼠使魔！寻宝仓鼠拉奇！

choice_prompt:7:1110103004.text: Isn't it obvious? I'm Trezzy, a treasure-hunting hamster familiar!
choice_prompt:7:1110103004.source_cn: 不明显吗？我当然是仓鼠使魔！寻宝仓鼠拉奇！

say:8:1110103006:0.text: Haven't you ever seen a treasure-hunting hamster before?
say:8:1110103006:0.source_cn: 咦？你们没有在别的地方见过我这样的寻宝仓鼠吗？

say:9:1110103007:1.text: I was sent into the desert by my master to search for treasure!
say:9:1110103007:1.source_cn: 我的主人也是魔法师，我就是被主人派来沙漠寻宝的！
say:9:1110103007:1.male: I was sent into the desert by my master to search for treasure!
say:9:1110103007:1.female: I was sent into the desert by my master to search for treasure!

say:10:1110103008:1.text: At first, I thought you two were also treasure-hunting hamsters. If you were, I'd never help you and give you directions, in case you find the treasure first!
say:10:1110103008:1.source_cn: 一开始，我以为两位也是寻宝仓鼠来着，还想着绝对不能给你...

choice_prompt:11:1110103008.text: At first, I thought you two were also treasure-hunting hamsters. If you were, I'd never help you and give you directions, in case you find the treasure first!
choice_prompt:11:1110103008.source_cn: 一开始，我以为两位也是寻宝仓鼠来着，还想着绝对不能给你们指路，免得你们先一步拿走宝物……

say:13:1110103009:0.text: Yeah, we're not after any treasure. Could you help us with some directions?
say:13:1110103009:0.source_cn: 我们不是来寻宝的。可以请你为我们指路吗？

say:14:1110103010:1.text: It would be great if you could help us out! We're looking for someone, so we need to find a settlement and ask around.
say:14:1110103010:1.source_cn: 你要是能给我们指路就太好了！其实我们是来找人的，需要找...

say:15:1110103011:0.text: Then you've found the right hamster! I know of a place along my treasure-hunting route!
say:15:1110103011:0.source_cn: 那你们问对鼠了！我的寻宝路线附近，确实有类似的地方！

say:17:1110103012:0.text: Just follow the path, and you can't miss it! It's near where I'll be searching. I hope our paths cross again! See you around!
say:17:1110103012:0.source_cn: 只要沿着这条路前进，就能看到啦。那也是我的寻宝必经之地...

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 竟然还有别的仓鼠使魔

say:20:1110103005:0.text: Hamster familiars make great treasure hunters!
say:20:1110103005:0.source_cn: 鼠是专门寻宝的使魔哦！

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 你和我的使魔很不一样

say:0:1110104001:0.text: That hamster burrowed into the sand and disappeared!
say:0:1110104001:0.source_cn: 寻宝仓鼠……钻进沙子里消失了！

say:1:1110104002:0.text: Chippy's instincts make him want to burrow, too! Must... fight... urge!
say:1:1110104002:0.source_cn: 野性的本能，让我也想埋进沙子里钻个痛快，呜呜！

say:2:1110104003:0.text: Let's restrain ourselves, shall we? It's time to move along.
say:2:1110104003:0.source_cn: 克制一下，我们先沿路前进吧。
say:2:1110104003:0.male: Let's restrain ourselves, shall we? It's time to move along.
say:2:1110104003:0.female: Let's restrain ourselves, shall we? It's time to move along.

say:0:1110105001:0.text: Hmm, is it possible to pass through here?
say:0:1110105001:0.source_cn: 鼠能不能钻洞通过去呢？

say:1:1110105002:0.source_cn: 可是这里刚塌方，好像有点危险！

say:4:1110106002:0.text: Trezzy, are you sure you're pointing us in the right direction?
say:4:1110106002:0.source_cn: 拉奇，你确定你给我们指的是正确的路吗？

say:5:1110106003:0.text: This should be the way, but with the landslide, there's no way to move forward!
say:5:1110106003:0.source_cn: 道路前面，这不全都被塌下来的沙土压实，一步也前进不了了吗……

say:7:1110106004:0.text: Of course, treasure hunting isn't always a picnic! Sometimes, one must find ways through high mountains and rough waters.
say:7:1110106004:0.source_cn: 寻宝的路当然不可能一帆风顺！作为寻宝仓鼠，逢山开路，遇...

choice_prompt:8:1110106004.text: Of course, treasure hunting isn't always a picnic! Sometimes, one must find ways through high mountains and rough waters.
choice_prompt:8:1110106004.source_cn: 寻宝的路当然不可能一帆风顺！作为寻宝仓鼠，逢山开路，遇水搭桥就好！

say:9:1110106005:0.text: I'm trying to work this out! Do you think if I tunnel through it, I'll be able to clear a path?
say:9:1110106005:0.source_cn: 我这不是正在想办法嘛！你们说，要是我在这里钻个洞挤过去...

say:10:1110106006:0.text: Are you serious? If it drops on you, you'll become a hamster pancake!
say:10:1110106006:0.source_cn: 你、你在说什么啊！你会变成鼠饼的！

say:11:1110106007:0.text: Not necessarily! Come on, you two could help me!
say:11:1110106007:0.source_cn: 也不一定吧！来，你们也要一起帮忙吗？

say:12:1110106008:0.text: You want three hamster pancakes instead of one?! Come on, is there no other way around?
say:12:1110106008:0.source_cn: 三个鼠饼也还是鼠饼啊！除了挖过去，难道就没有别的办法了吗？

say:13:1110106009:0.text: There is a long way around, but what fun would that be, am I right?
say:13:1110106009:0.source_cn: 倒是也有一条远路可以绕……不过那样又有什么乐趣呢，你们...

choice_prompt:15:1110106009.text: There is a long way around, but what fun would that be, am I right?
choice_prompt:15:1110106009.source_cn: 倒是也有一条远路可以绕……不过那样又有什么乐趣呢，你们说对吧！

say:16:1110106010:0.text: Alas, I can't expect you to understand the appeal of treasure hunting. Alright, you head that way.
say:16:1110106010:0.source_cn: 唉，果然不能期望你们懂得寻宝的浪漫。好吧……你们可以往...

say:17:1110106011:0.text: Beware of landslides, wild animals, sandstorms, and every other unforeseen circumstance you could possibly dream up. Go forth boldly, my friends!
say:17:1110106011:0.source_cn: 小心塌方，小心野兽，小心沙暴，小心……嗯，小心各种可能...

say:18:1110106012:0.text: Chippy is scared that this path may also turn him into a hamster pancake...
say:18:1110106012:0.source_cn: 总觉得这条路上也埋伏着把我们变成鼠饼的危险……

choice:15:0:1.text: Tell me about the other path.
choice:15:0:1.male: Tell me about the other path.
choice:15:0:1.female: Tell me about the other path.

choice:8:1:2.text: How will you clear the way?
choice:8:1:2.male: How will you clear the way?
choice:8:1:2.female: How will you clear the way?

say:0:1110107001:0.text: Have a safe journey! I'll be here analyzing my options.
say:0:1110107001:0.source_cn: 一路顺风！我还要在这里思考一会。

say:0:1110108001:0.text: It's rough going through the desert, everything is so dry!
say:0:1110108001:0.source_cn: 呼……在沙漠里前行还真费劲，虽然是很干爽啦。

say:1:1110108002:0.text: *Cough*... There seems to be a lot of dust in the air! Chippy, what did Trezzy warn us about again?
say:1:1110108002:0.source_cn: 咳咳，空气里忽然好多沙尘！满满，寻宝仓鼠让我们提防什么来着？

say:2:1110108003:0.text: Landslides, wild animals, and... sandstorms! Run!
say:2:1110108003:0.source_cn: ……塌方，野兽，沙暴？这声音，是沙暴！快跑啊！

say:0:1110109001:0.text: *Cough*... Magister, look! Let's take shelter there!
say:0:1110109001:0.source_cn: 咳咳，主人，前面有个山谷，我们去那里避一避吧！
say:0:1110109001:0.male: *Cough*... Magister, look! Let's take shelter there!
say:0:1110109001:0.female: *Cough*... Magister, look! Let's take shelter there!

say:1:1110109002:0.text: There's a heap of sand and stones blocking our way!
say:1:1110109002:0.source_cn: 那边好像堆积了沙石，我们进不去！

say:2:1110109003:0.text: Don't worry. That angry beast looks like it could be of some use.
say:2:1110109003:0.source_cn: 别急，那个愤怒的野兽看起来能帮上忙。
say:2:1110109003:0.male: Don't worry. That angry beast looks like it could be of some use.
say:2:1110109003:0.female: Don't worry. That angry beast looks like it could be of some use.

say:0:1110110001:0.text: The beast crashed through the pass! You're a genius, Magister!
say:0:1110110001:0.source_cn: 让那个野兽撞开隘口？主人真是天才！
say:0:1110110001:0.male: The beast crashed through the pass! You're a genius, Magister!
say:0:1110110001:0.female: The beast crashed through the pass! You're a genius, Magister!

say:1:1110110002:0.text: Let's get inside! The dust is getting worse!
say:1:1110110002:0.source_cn: 快躲进去吧，沙尘越来越多了……
say:1:1110110002:0.male: Let's get inside! The dust is getting worse!
say:1:1110110002:0.female: Let's get inside! The dust is getting worse!

say:1:1110111001:1.text: Who is this scaly busybody?! Are you trying to harm Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?!
say:1:1110111001:1.source_cn: 什么东西！可、可怕的毛团！你、你是不是要对<style...
say:1:1110111001:1.male: Who is this scaly busybody?! Are you trying to harm Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?!
say:1:1110111001:1.female: Who is this scaly busybody?! Are you trying to harm Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>?!

say:2:1110111002:1.text: I'm only here to take shelter from that mammoth of a sandstorm. My name is Alsa, a member of the Uru Clan!
say:2:1110111002:1.source_cn: 我只是来躲避沙尘的蛮血。我叫阿尔萨，乌尔氏族的阿尔萨！

say:3:1110111003:2.text: You look like strangers to the desert. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, eh? Aside from caravans, guests from afar are rare here.
say:3:1110111003:2.source_cn: 你们看起来是从沙漠外面来的？<style=stress...
say:3:1110111003:2.male: You look like strangers to the desert. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, eh? Aside from caravans, guests from afar are rare here.
say:3:1110111003:2.female: You look like strangers to the desert. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, eh? Aside from caravans, guests from afar are rare here.

say:4:1110111004:1.text: You must be here for the <style="highlight">Warsong Festival</style>, yes?
say:4:1110111004:1.source_cn: 对了，你们一定是来围观<style=highlight...

choice_prompt:5:1110111004.text: You must be here for the <style="highlight">Warsong Festival</style>, yes?
choice_prompt:5:1110111004.source_cn: 对了，你们一定是来围观<style=highlight>战歌节</style>的吧？

say:6:1110111005:1.text: Seems I was wrong. Still, you'd do well to come. It's a grand event for us Maulers!
say:6:1110111005:1.source_cn: 看来不是这个原因。还是建议你们去看看呢，这可是我们蛮血...

say:7:1110111006:1.text: To meet like this in the desert must be the will of the Dusk Lord. So, please come as guests of the Uru Clan!
say:7:1110111006:1.source_cn: 不过，能够在这片沙漠遇见，也一定是残阳神的指引。所以，...

choice_prompt:8:1110111006.text: To meet like this in the desert must be the will of the Dusk Lord. So, please come as guests of the Uru Clan!
choice_prompt:8:1110111006.source_cn: 不过，能够在这片沙漠遇见，也一定是残阳神的指引。所以，请到我们乌尔氏族做客吧！

say:9:1110111007:1.text: Of course! You guys don't have a place to stay, right?
say:9:1110111007:1.source_cn: 当然！你们也需要休整吧？

say:10:1110111009:1.text: Besides, our pops always said if you want to survive in the desert, you need more friends than enemies. If the weak want to survive, they've got to band together.
say:10:1110111009:1.source_cn: 毕竟老爹说过，想在沙漠生存，一定要多交朋友少树敌！只有...

say:11:1110111010:1.text: You don't mind others thinking you're weak?
say:11:1110111010:1.source_cn: 被当做是弱者……这是什么值得高兴的事吗？

say:12:1110111011:1.text: The weak always huddle together. This means as long as one is weak, they're never alone... isn't that great?
say:12:1110111011:1.source_cn: 小仓鼠，弱者总是相互依偎。这意味着只要弱小，就绝对不会...

choice_prompt:13:1110111011.text: The weak always huddle together. This means as long as one is weak, they're never alone... isn't that great?
choice_prompt:13:1110111011.source_cn: 小仓鼠，弱者总是相互依偎。这意味着只要弱小，就绝对不会孤独……难道不是很棒吗？

say:14:1110111012:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，我就知道你能理解！

say:15:1110111014:2.text: So, you've come all this way to the desert. Anything I can do to help?
say:15:1110111014:2.source_cn: 你们大老远地跑来沙漠，有什么事是我可以帮得上忙的吗？

say:16:1110111015:1.text: We are, in fact, searching for someone... But Magister, do you think we can really trust this sneaky ball of fluff?
say:16:1110111015:1.source_cn: 其实我们是来找人的，确实也需要找个地方打听一番……不过...
say:16:1110111015:1.male: We are, in fact, searching for someone... But Magister, do you think we can really trust this sneaky ball of fluff?
say:16:1110111015:1.female: We are, in fact, searching for someone... But Magister, do you think we can really trust this sneaky ball of fluff?

say:17:1110111016:1.text: Hey, I'm not some sneaky ball of fluff! You can ask anyone around here about me. Everyone will say that Alsa is the friendliest girl in the Ashen Wastes and a pretty fast runner to boot.
say:17:1110111016:1.source_cn: 我不是毛团，也不可疑啦！你们可以去打听打听，我阿尔萨的...

say:19:1110111018:1.text: We of the Uru Clan are welcoming to all! That said, other clans aren't quite like us...
say:19:1110111018:1.source_cn: 我们乌尔氏族最热情好客了！话说在前面，别的氏族可不一定...

say:20:1110111019:2.text: I would never leave stranded travelers to fend for themselves in this desert! Come with me!
say:20:1110111019:2.source_cn: 所以，我是绝不会放着走投无路的旅人不管的！跟我走吧！

choice_prompt:21:1110111019.text: I would never leave stranded travelers to fend for themselves in this desert! Come with me!
choice_prompt:21:1110111019.source_cn: 所以，我是绝不会放着走投无路的旅人不管的！跟我走吧！

say:22:1110111020:1.text: Rest assured, Magister. Sir Chippy will guard your back!
say:22:1110111020:1.source_cn: 主人放心，骑士满满也会守护主人的安全！
say:22:1110111020:1.male: Rest assured, Magister. Sir Chippy will guard your back!
say:22:1110111020:1.female: Rest assured, Magister. Sir Chippy will guard your back!

say:23:1110111021:1.text: Chippy? Is that the name of this little hamster in armor? He's so cute! What's the other one called?
say:23:1110111021:1.source_cn: 满满？这是小仓鼠的名字吗？真可爱！另一只小仓鼠呢？

say:24:1110111022:1.text: I'm Hammie. What's your angle, furball?
say:24:1110111022:1.source_cn: 我是漫漫，可疑的毛团你想做什么？

say:25:1110111023:1.text: Relax! We animal friends gotta stick together, so let's be friends from now on!
say:25:1110111023:1.source_cn: 别紧张，我们都毛茸茸的，更应该做朋友！

say:27:1110111013:1.text: Thanks! That sounds like a compliment!
say:27:1110111013:1.male: Thanks! That sounds like a compliment!
say:27:1110111013:1.female: Thanks! That sounds like a compliment!

say:28:1110111008:1.text: Apologies, was I moving too fast? I like entertaining guests. Consider it one of my vices.
say:28:1110111008:1.source_cn: 呃，不好意思……进展太快了吗？我喜欢招待客人，就当是我...

say:0:1110112001:0.text: The sandstorm has passed. Come on, follow me!
say:0:1110112001:0.source_cn: 沙暴过去了。各位，跟上我，出发咯！

say:0:1110113001:0.text: It's a bit of a hike, but the upside is that we'll pass through a hunting area, so finding dinner will be a breeze!
say:0:1110113001:0.source_cn: 这条路有点远，不过好处是经过猎区，今天的晚饭又有着落咯！

say:1:1110113002:0.text: Does everyone in your clan go out hunting?
say:1:1110113002:0.source_cn: 你们氏族里，大家都要出门打猎吗？

say:2:1110113003:0.text: Mostly just me and Soren. The other Maulers are too young, but they help with things like gathering wood.
say:2:1110113003:0.source_cn: 主要是我跟索恩出门，其他的蛮血还小。但采摘，捡柴，做饭...

say:0:1110114001:0.text: What is it like where the Uru Clan lives?
say:0:1110114001:0.source_cn: 乌尔氏族生活的地方是什么样呢？

say:1:1110114002:0.text: There's an oasis with enough water for everyone, and there's good hunting nearby. We're surviving.
say:1:1110114002:0.source_cn: 我们的绿洲有水源，附近还能打猎。大家互帮互助，都能勉强...

say:2:1110114003:0.text: There's no point in raiding us since we don't have a lot, but we do enough to get by. It's enough for a home.
say:2:1110114003:0.source_cn: 没有富足到让别人来抢，也没有贫瘠到让我们活不下去。那就...

say:1:1110116001:0.text: That was easy! That's a good haul of meat, too. What a nice catch!
say:1:1110116001:0.source_cn: 呼，搞定！收获了一大堆肉……真是体贴的野猪！
say:1:1110116001:0.male: That was easy! That's a good haul of meat, too. What a nice catch!
say:1:1110116001:0.female: That was easy! That's a good haul of meat, too. What a nice catch!

say:2:1110116002:0.text: It must've known we needed more food for our guests...
say:2:1110116002:0.source_cn: 难道是怕我们没余粮招待客人？
say:2:1110116002:0.male: It must've known we needed more food for our guests...
say:2:1110116002:0.female: It must've known we needed more food for our guests...

choice_prompt:3:1110116002.text: It must've known we needed more food for our guests...
choice_prompt:3:1110116002.source_cn: 难道是怕我们没余粮招待客人？
choice_prompt:3:1110116002.male: It must've known we needed more food for our guests...
choice_prompt:3:1110116002.female: It must've known we needed more food for our guests...

say:4:1110116003:0.text: This is the Ashen Wastes. Even weak Maulers could do as much.
say:4:1110116003:0.source_cn: 这里是荒角沙漠。即使是弱者，也不能连这点小事都做不到吧。
